title: Proposition 8.24: fpqc locality on the target for locally finite presentation
statement_scope: The condition that a morphism f:X -> Y of spectral Deligne-Mumford stacks be locally of finite presentation to order n (locally almost of finite presentation, locally of finite presentation) is local on the target with respect to the fpqc topology. That is, if there exists a flat covering {∐ Yα -> Y} such that each induced map fα:Yα ×_Y X -> Yα is locally of finite presentation to order n (locally almost of finite presentation, locally of finite presentation), then f has the same property. Whole proposition.
